title: Consider writing .agents/skills/lore/SKILL.md for an Antigravity target (later release; design question for opum-doc)
description: Follow-up from opum-doc's Antigravity ruling on ODOC-556 (recorded 2026-10-31T04:48:56Z; opum-doc origin/dev). Ruling for quest: an Antigravity target writes .agents/skills/<tool>/SKILL.md, the same file as a Codex target, because Google's Antigravity docs list <workspace-root>/.agents/skills/<skill-folder>/ as the workspace skill location. For lore, the leader's relayed answer (A) is that the clause is vacuous today and nothing changes in 0.14.2: lore init --antigravity (and the wizard option) writes ONE file, GEMINI.md (src/core/antigravity-bridge.ts), no skill, and is not an agents --check runtime. This task is the later-release question: should lore write .agents/skills/lore/SKILL.md for an Antigravity target? That design question is OPEN and is NOT decided here; it goes to opum-doc. Not a blocker for 0.14.2.
